canonical_data: a per-project SQLite graph of code symbols, call edges, and file hashes with a full-text index
strengths: Publishes per-language and per-framework extraction coverage measured on named public repositories rather than asserting accuracy
One SQLite graph serves nine coding agents plus a command line, an embeddable library, and a browser viewer
Marks uncertain edges as uncertain instead of presenting inferred relationships as fact
weaknesses: Telemetry ships enabled by default, with opt-out only after the installer prompt or an environment variable
Two continuous integration workflows, neither running tests, despite 236 test files in the repository
The schema keeps only current state, so no query can ask what the graph looked like before a change
why_it_matters: Demonstrates that a code graph is more useful as shared local infrastructure many agents query than as a retrieval feature bundled inside one of them.
